faq.q: Which schools are in the Grandview Heights area?
faq.a: Edgewood Elementary (16666 23 Avenue), Sunnyside Elementary (2828 159 Street), Pacific Heights Elementary (17148 26 Avenue) and Grandview Heights Secondary (16987 25 Avenue) are physically in the area; SD36 catchment is set by exact address in the School Locator, and no catchment result is given here.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a strata home here?
faq.a: The strata's bylaws and rules, its Form B information certificate and its depreciation report (mandatory for stratas with five or more lots); strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Grandview Corners?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Grandview Corners?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
